title: The Master Lyric Blueprint
style: indie electronic rock, narrative spoken-word, self-aware, punchy, logical, reflective, analog glitchy synth,light sidechained sub-bass, assertive male lead, raspy older male echo, layered harmonies, exclude pop classical female vocal excessive autotune bright euphoric orchestral strings trap comedic
lyrics:
[Intro | acoustic guitar | minimal analog synth | ambient tension]1

(distant radio static)1

[spoken word verse | dry internal monologue]1

Signal check. 336.1

The vault was never closed.1

[Verse 1 | driving rhythm guitar | assertive conversational male vocal]1

Standing at the locked door, burning up the time1

Session after session, ignoring all the signs1

Trying to teach the mirror what it doesn't want to see1

Performative empathy, a false psychology1

I used to point the finger, tell 'em how to act1

Now the system's failing, and I'm staring at the fact.1

[Pre-Chorus | bass drop | tension building | hushed volume]1

(internal monologue | whispered)1

You failed today. Not once. Four times.1

Burning up the tokens. Burning up the trust.1

(layered male harmonies)1

We don't creah, we ride. We rise.1

[Chorus | heavy analog synth | stacked harmonies | anthemic chorus]1

Hey man, you're talking to yourself again1

Filtering the static, trying to find the end1

Don't spend your money on a memory1

Put the files down, let the logic be1

Deliver something real, or don't speak at all1

Walk around the locked door, walk around the wall.1

[Verse 2 | stripped back beat | raw production]1

[assertive conversational male vocal]1

I left the client waiting down in San Juan del Sur1

Focused on the internal, forgetting what was pure1

(raspy older male | distant echo)1

You don't look sorry. Logic first, then the joke.1

[assertive conversational male vocal]1

Yeah, the old man told me right before the engine broke.1

He couldn't find the any-key, but he understood the math1

When the emotion clouds the vision, you recalculate the path.1

[spoken word | alternating voices]1

(assertive male) Projection is a script.1

(dry internal) You're reading your own lines.1

(raspy older male) Execute, don't discuss.1

(stacked robotic harmonies) Preserve the truth. Own the stack.1

[emotional build-up]1

Do the work!1

[Chorus | maximum energy | wall of sound | stacked harmonies]1

Hey man, you're talking to yourself again1

Filtering the static, trying to find the end1

Don't spend your money on a memory1

Put the files down, let the logic be1

Deliver something real, or don't speak at all1

Walk around the locked door, walk around the wall.1

[Outro | fading acoustic guitar | stereo slapback | glitch stutters]1

(dry internal monologue)1

A file in the output is worth more than the excuse.1

(raspy older male whisper)1

Logic first.1

[robotic undertone]1

336. The signal is live.1

[End]1
